description: Media queries on user preferences in the stylesheet, as Chromium 153 evaluates them (Bootstrap 5.3's and Tailwind's motion-safe rules): prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-contrast and forced-colors with and without values and under `not`, without a preference (the harness's Chromium), then with reduced motion and more contrast emulated, then without them again; a @charset "UTF-8" rule
